title: Group Assistant Manager / Manager – Talent Acquisition
experience: 8–20 years of experience in Talent Acquisition/Recruitment. Minimum 2 years of experience in a managerial/supervisory capacity.
qualification: Healthcare recruitment experience preferred. Strong knowledge of recruitment best practices and healthcare hiring protocols. Excellent communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills. Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
other_details: Key Responsibilities: Manage and coordinate with recruitment team for medical and non-medical positions, including Doctors, Nurses and Operations staff. Handle high-volume, multi-location hiring across hospital units. Develop and implement effective talent acquisition strategies. Ensure compliance with healthcare hiring practices and employment laws. Manage recruitment through ATS & HRIS tools (Spine Software). Coordinate with stakeholders and hiring managers to close positions within timelines. Working Days & Hours: Monday–Saturday | 10:00 AM–6:00 PM. Interested candidates can share their CV with: recruit@srvhospital.com / recruitment.chembur@srvhospital.come / recruit.chembur@srvhospital.com. Please mention your current salary, expected salary and notice period in your email. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
